app.title: Dwaar committee console
app.description: Committee console for gated communities: residents, security and settings.
shell.simulation: Local simulation: not real people or providers
society.confirm_body: Every page will reload and show only data of the society you choose. Nothing from the current society stays on screen, and unsaved changes are discarded.
society.switched_banner: You are now working in {society}. All data on screen belongs to this society.
society.pick_body: {name}, you have committee access in more than one society. Choose which one to work in. You can switch later; the console never switches for you.
no_access.title: No committee console access
no_access.body: Your account has no committee console role in any society. If you believe this is wrong, ask your society secretary.
forbidden.title: You cannot open this page
error.society_changed: The society selected in this browser changed in another tab or window. Reload the page to continue in the society now selected.
reason.maker_checker: A different person must take this decision (maker and checker cannot be the same person).
reason.review_first: Start the supervisor review before resolving.
reason.import_validation_failed: The file has errors, so nothing was imported.
reason.mfa_already_enrolled: An authenticator is already enrolled for this account.
reason.no_society_selected: No society is selected. Choose a society first.
reason.csrf: The request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: Use the mobile number registered with your society. Committee roles need a second step with an authenticator code.
signin.simulator_note: Local simulator (simulation=true): no SMS is sent. The code is shown here only because this is a local demonstration.
signin.totp_intro: Your role requires a second factor. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator.
signin.enrol_needed: No authenticator is enrolled for this account yet.
signin.enrol_secret: Add this secret to your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows:
chart.capped: At least one count reached the 100-row limit of the list API and is shown as 100+.
overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Operational counters for {society}, computed from the live exception queue and device list.
overview.no_widgets: There are no operational counters for your role in this society.
overview.exceptions_by_kind_note: Open, in supervisor review and escalated exceptions. The table below carries every number shown in the chart.
units.title: Units
units.description: Blocks and units of the society. Filters are applied by the server; the table shows one page at a time.
units.col.label: Unit
import.title: Bulk import of units
import.intro: Upload a CSV, check it with a dry run, then import. The file is validated completely before anything is written.
import.all_or_nothing: All or nothing: if even one row is wrong, no unit and no block is created.
import.columns: Required columns: block, label, floor. Optional: carpet_area_sqft, builtup_area_sqft, undivided_interest_pct, construction_cost_paise (whole paise).
import.create_blocks: Create blocks that do not exist yet
import.validate_first: Run the dry run for this file and these options before importing.
import.valid: Dry run passed: {rows} rows are valid. New blocks to create: {blocks}. Nothing has been written yet.
import.invalid: Validation failed: {total} problems in {rows} rows. Nothing has been written.
import.nothing_written: Nothing was imported: the whole file was rejected.
import.confirm_body: This creates the units (and any new blocks) listed in the dry run in one step. It cannot be undone from this screen. The server checks the file again and writes nothing if anything has changed.
import.code.already_exists: A unit with this block and label already exists (archived units keep their label).
import.code.builtup_area_below_carpet_ar: Built-up area is smaller than carpet area.
import.code.column_count: The row has a different number of columns than the header.
import.code.conflict_retry: Another change happened at the same time. Validate again and retry.
import.code.duplicate_column: The column appears more than once.
import.code.duplicate_in_file: The same block and label appear more than once in the file.
import.code.floor_exceeds_block_floors: The floor is higher than the number of floors of the block.
import.code.malformed_csv: The file is not valid CSV.
import.code.nul_byte: The file contains a NUL byte.
import.code.out_of_range: The value is outside the allowed range.
import.code.too_many_rows: Too many rows in one file.
import.code.undivided_interest_total_exc: The undivided interest of all active units would exceed 100 percent.
import.code.unknown_block: The block does not exist. Tick the option to create missing blocks, or fix the name.
import.code.unsafe_cell: The cell starts with = + - or @ and is refused (spreadsheet formula injection).
gates.title: Gates and lanes
gates.description: Gates and lanes configured for this society, and the gate policy that governs approvals and overstay.
gates.col.name: Gate
policy.title: Gate policy
policy.intro: Limits applied by the local gate policy. The server enforces the allowed bounds.
policy.no_auto_allow: No automatic allow on timeout: an unanswered request never lets a visitor in.
policy.auto_allow_on: Automatic allow on timeout is reported as ON by the API. This must never be on; report it.
policy.read_only: Only the secretary can change the policy.
policy.confirm_body: These values apply to every gate of this society from now on. Entries already approved keep their validity. The change is recorded in the audit log.
devices.title: Gate devices
devices.description: Enrolment requests wait for a different person to approve them. A device cannot be used until it is approved, and a revoked device stops working.
devices.read_only: You can see device status. Approval and revocation are done by the secretary or the guard supervisor.
devices.col.name: Device
devices.reason_required: Reason (at least 5 characters, recorded in the audit log)
devices.reason_optional: Reason (optional, recorded in the audit log)
devices.confirm_body.approve: The device becomes active and can start sending gate events for this society. You cannot approve a device you requested yourself.
devices.confirm_body.reject: The enrolment is closed and the device stays unusable.
devices.confirm_body.revoke: The device stops being trusted immediately. This cannot be undone: it must be enrolled and approved again.
visits.title: Visits
visits.description: The visit register shows exactly what was recorded: submitted, approved but not yet entered, entered, exited. State your purpose: each look at the register is recorded in the audit log.
visits.description_guard: Active visits at one gate. Details of residents are not shown.
visits.purpose_hint: For example: checking an overstay alert.
visits.purpose_first: Enter a purpose and load the register.
visits.choose_gate_first: Choose a gate to see its entries.
requests.title: Approval requests at a gate
requests.note: Visible to the guard supervisor. Committee roles do not see individual household approvals.
exceptions.title: Gate exceptions
exceptions.description: Manual and emergency entries, unauthorised entries, unobserved exits and overstays. A supervisor reviews each one, then resolves or escalates it.
exceptions.read_only: You can see the exception queue. Review is done by the guard supervisor or the secretary.
exceptions.capped: The list shows at most 100 exceptions. Use the filters to narrow it.
exceptions.note_required: Resolution note (at least 5 characters, recorded in the audit log)
exceptions.confirm_body.start_review: The exception moves to supervisor review under your name.
exceptions.confirm_body.escalate: The exception goes to the committee secretary, who alone can close it.
exceptions.confirm_body.resolve: The exception is closed with your note. For manual and emergency entries, the person who authorised the entry cannot resolve it.
exceptions.receipt.start_review: Exception {id} is now in supervisor review.
settings.title: Society settings
settings.description: Society details, legal and tax packs, and feature flags. These are shown as configured; this page does not change them.
settings.name: Name
settings.blocker.legal_pack_not_approved: The legal pack has not been approved.
settings.blocker.feature_flag_disabled: The binding governance feature flag is off.
settings.pack_note: Legal rules are configuration. Until a pack is approved by the responsible reviewers, no vote, notice or interest rule is treated as binding.
settings.simulators_active: Active: identity and messaging are simulated and no real provider is contacted.
settings.live_providers_unknown: The API does not report live provider status yet (payments, telephony, hardware).
sessions.title: Your sessions
sessions.description: Browsers and devices signed in as you. Revoke any you do not recognise; it takes effect immediately.
sessions.confirm_body: The device is signed out at once and must sign in again. This session stays signed in.
